game_concept: A survival strategy set in The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse, the fortified castle gatehouse: the knight must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Rename Rush: Pick valid variable names (no spaces, no leading digits) to unlock doors across the area.
theme: The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse: the fortified castle gatehouse
core_gameplay_loop: In Castle Gatehouse, repeat each round: Pick valid variable names (no spaces, no leading digits) to unlock doors across the area. Each round, goblin raiders strike the royal vault, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the valid_names value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the royal vault from goblin raiders in Castle Gatehouse: keep the valid_names meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: valid_names drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 45-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 6 (applied tier): Rename Rush
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rename Rush' (Week 1 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Castle Gatehouse'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how valid_names changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Castle Gatehouse.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 45 seconds while valid_names > 0.
